q: Whose scope is the electricity and cooking fuel at a construction labour camp?
title: Labour camp power and fuel: whose scope
short: If the camp runs on your electricity connection or your genset, it is your Scope 2 or Scope 1. If the contractor runs the camp on its own supply, it is the contractor's Scope 1 and 2 and your Scope 3. LPG supplied for workers' cooking follows whoever buys it.
audience: Builders, EPC contractors and project owners

ul: Whose name is on the electricity bill or temporary connection.

p: State in the contract who reports camp energy, so neither side leaves it out or both count it.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
